purpose: Help users find important TradingView navigation options and features.

items.name: Profile
items.description: Opens the user's TradingView profile area.

items.name: Market Summary
items.description: Summary of market information shown on the TradingView home page.

items.name: Community Ideas
items.description: Displays ideas shared by the TradingView community.

items.name: Indicators
items.description: Home-page content related to newly featured or discussed indicators.

items.name: Strategies
items.description: Home-page content related to trading strategies.

items.name: Top Stories and News
items.description: Displays important stories and market news.

items.name: US Stocks
items.description: Displays information related to US stocks.

items.name: Highest Volume Stocks
items.description: Shows US stocks with high trading volume.

items.name: Stock Losers
items.description: Shows stocks that are losing value.

instrument_search.name: Instrument Search
instrument_search.purpose: Find a specific trading instrument or symbol.

example.action: Search for XAUUSD using instrument search.

chart.name: Trading Chart
chart.purpose: Chart and analysis interface for a selected instrument.

visible_options.name: Indicators
visible_options.description: Opens indicators used for chart analysis.

visible_options.name: Drawing Tools
visible_options.description: Provides tools for drawing and marking directly on the chart.

visible_options.name: Alert
visible_options.description: Creates or manages alerts for the selected instrument.

visible_options.name: Redo
visible_options.description: Redoes a previously undone chart action.

visible_options.name: Watchlist / Alerts Panel
visible_options.description: Right-side panel containing chart-related information and alerts.

example_user_queries.action: Use Search or Ctrl+K and search for XAUUSD.

example_user_queries.query: How do I add an indicator?
example_user_queries.action: Open Indicators from the chart toolbar.

example_user_queries.query: How do I change the timeframe?
example_user_queries.action: Use the timeframe control on the chart toolbar.

example_user_queries.query: How do I set an alert?
example_user_queries.action: Use the Alert option on the chart.
Use the drawing tools available on the chart.

example_user_queries.query: Where can I find high volume stocks?
example_user_queries.action: Open the Highest Volume Stocks market list.

example_user_queries.query: Where can I find volatile stocks?
example_user_queries.action: Open the Most Volatile Stocks market list.
